calibration.source: Live runs 2026-10-12 06:18-06:42 UTC against https://firetrident.mattsolt.workers.dev (colony bench-w2-load, OpenSpec trunk, regionDepth 3). See results/2026-10-12/calibration.md for the derivation.

notes.takeMs: in-platform take: laptop p50 at N=10 (354 ms) minus the laptop round trip (~100 ms)
notes.proposeMs: laptop p50 115-155 ms minus ~100 ms round trip
notes.laneOverheadMs: trunk blobs, base blobs and lineage-context RPCs before TrunkDO.land; from the batch-cost intercept (first proposal to landing receipt ~1.06 s) minus the commit intercept
notes.commitBaseMs: trunk writer time per commit independent of batch size: commit gaps p50 551-829 ms at mean batch 1.0-2.0 in the swarm runs, minus 72 ms per proposal (drifts from ~480 to ~700 ms as load and trunk history grow; 620 is the middle)
notes.commitPerProposalMs: slope of landing time vs batch size in the batch-cost runs (k = 2, 8, 24, 49 in one region): 71.8 ms per proposal (pull blob from the workspace, verify, write)
notes.landMs: baseline merge queue: one change landed by the same writer = commitBaseMs + commitPerProposalMs
notes.rebaseMs: baseline rebase of a stale change on Artifacts: fetch trunk (spike: 230-247 ms) + replay and commit (spike: 91 ms) = ~350 ms; checks re-run separately (testMs)
notes.testMs: 0: checks cost nothing in the headline runs (most favourable to the baseline, which re-runs them serially after every rebase)
